title: Great Is the Lord

questions.question: I will extol you, my God and King, and bless your name how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 145:1 (ESV): "and bless your name forever and ever."

questions.question: Every day I will bless you and praise your name forever and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 145:2 (ESV): "and praise your name forever and ever."

questions.question: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised, and his greatness is what?
One generation shall commend your works to another, and shall declare your mighty what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 145:4 (ESV): "and shall declare your mighty acts."

questions.question: The Lord is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 145:8 (ESV): "slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love."

questions.question: The Lord is good to all, and his mercy is over all that he has what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 145:9 (ESV): "and his mercy is over all that he has made."

questions.question: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures throughout all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 145:13 (ESV): "and your dominion endures throughout all generations."

questions.question: The Lord upholds all who are falling and raises up all who are what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 145:14 (ESV): "and raises up all who are bowed down."

questions.question: The eyes of all look to you, and you give them their food in due what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 145:15 (ESV): "and you give them their food in due season."

questions.question: You open your hand; you satisfy the desire of every living what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 145:16 (ESV): "you satisfy the desire of every living thing."

questions.question: The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 145:18 (ESV): "to all who call on him in truth."

questions.question: He fulfills the desire of those who fear him; he also hears their cry and does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 145:19 (ESV): "he also hears their cry and saves them."

questions.question: The Lord preserves all who love him, but all the wicked he will do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 145:20 (ESV): "but all the wicked he will destroy."

questions.question: What kind of poem is Psalm 145?
questions.explanation: It is an acrostic poem, though one letter (Nun) is missing in the Masoretic text (but present in DSS/LXX).

questions.question: My mouth will speak the praise of the Lord, and let all flesh bless his holy name how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 145:21 (ESV): "and let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever."

key_verse_text: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised, and his greatness is unsearchable.
